reason: JRC Integrated Systems is a 2003-founded, ~155-500 person, ~$38.5M-revenue DoD systems-engineering CONSULTING firm (no venture funding, 7 locations, DoD Mentor Protege Program member) that sells the same services Barry Hess sells - systems engineering, C4I integration, cybersecurity and program support to MDA/Navy/NASA - so it is both a competing consultancy and far too large and mature for a fractional CTO engagement; every matched posting (Model-Based Systems Engineer, C4I System Engineer, Senior Cyber Security Specialist, Facilities Planning Analyst) is a billable contract seat backfill on an existing MDA program in Dahlgren/Huntsville, not a confession of a startup missing cleared technical leadership between prototype and fielding, and no live line redescribes his valley-of-death EDP.
